steps.en: Install neo and sign into only the accounts the agent may use
steps.zh: 安装 neo，仅登录授权助手使用的账号

steps.en: Connect your existing assistant to the endpoint shown in the MCP panel
steps.zh: 把已有助手连接到 MCP 面板显示的地址

steps.en: Makes this persistent browser available as tools to the assistant
steps.zh: 向助手提供常驻浏览器工具

steps.en: Ask the assistant to summarize unread mail
steps.code: Summarize my important unread emails from the last two days.

steps.en: Executes the assistant's browser actions using the signed-in accounts
steps.zh: 使用已登录账号执行助手的浏览器动作

steps.en: Keeps the session timeline and page replay on local disk
steps.zh: 把会话时间线和页面回放保存在本地

value.en: Use existing account access without another sign-in flow, and inspect what the agent did
value.zh: 不用重做登录流程，也能检查助手操作过什么
